description: This PHP class defines a model 'TerminationReasonConfigurationModel' used for representing termination reason configurations within the OrangeHRM API. It implements the 'Normalizable' interface and utilizes traits for serialization, encapsulating a 'TerminationReason' entity and providing schema annotations for API documentation.
